question:
**Directions: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

AIM
solution:
The correct answer is 'Purpose.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given word 'Aim' means **something that you intend to do; a purpose**. (लक्ष्‍य, उद्देश्‍य)

 
 
• Example: *Living without an **aim** is like sailing without a compass*.
 
 
 
• ​Let's see the meaning of other given options:-
 
 
• '**Courage**' means **the ability to control fear in a situation that may be dangerous or unpleasant**. (साहस, हिम्‍मत, बहादुरी)
 
 
• Example: *He was famous for his **courage** in defending his country*.
 
 
 
• '**Selection**' means **choosing or being chosen**. (चयन करना या चुना जाना; चयन)
 
 
• Example: *The new leader is a good **selection***.
 
 
 
• '**Purpose**' means **the aim or intention of something**. (उद्देश्‍य, आशय या इरादा)
 
 
• Example: *His **purpose** was to make a profit by improving the company's performance*.
 
 
 
• '**Shot**' means **a try at doing something; an attempt**. (कुछ करने की कोशिश; प्रयास)
 
 
• Example: *Let me have a **shot** at it*.

 
 
 
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is option 3.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The synonyms of the word 'Aim' are "purpose, plan, intend".
 
• The antonyms of the word 'Aim' are "neglect, **abandonment**, **inadvertence**".
